connector.name: Iso27001 MCP
connector.registryDescription: ISO 27001 compliance workspace for Claude. Risks, policies, SoA, evidence, and audit workflows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package iso27001-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sushegaad account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: 32-byte hex key for AES-256 SQLite encryption (generated by iso27001-mcp init)

env.name: HMAC_SECRET
env.description: 32-byte hex secret for HMAC-signing API keys (generated by iso27001-mcp init)

env.name: MCP_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticating tool calls (generated by iso27001-mcp keygen)

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the encrypted SQLite database file
